abstract: Background: Choriocarcinoma is a rare, aggressive subtype of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. The diagnosis of metastatic choriocarcinoma in the setting of a viable intrauterine pregnancy is exceedingly rare and often associated with feto-maternal hemorrhage. Case: An otherwise healthy Gravida 1 Para 0 at 34 weeks gestational age presented with metastatic choriocarcinoma and a viable fetus. Measured Doppler peak systolic velocity of the middle cerebral artery was used to detect fetal anemia, thus optimising the timing of delivery. Conclusion: This is the first case report to our knowledge using Doppler ultrasonography to detect fetal anemia in an effort to guide delivery in a case of choriocarcinoma diagnosed during pregnancy. If choriocarcinoma is diagnosed during pregnancy, middle cerebral artery Doppler ultrasonography may serve as a critical tool to help detect anemia, allowing pregnancy prolongation to promote fetal maturity while screening for the development of feto-maternal hemorrhage.
abstract_ja: 背景:絨毛癌は妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍のまれで侵襲性の高い亜型です。生存子宮内妊娠に転移性絨毛癌を合併する症例は極めてまれで、しばしば胎児母体間出血を伴います。症例:妊娠34週の妊娠歴G1P0の健康な女性が、転移性絨毛癌と生存胎児を有して来院しました。胎児貧血の検出には中大脳動脈の最大収縮期血流速度を用いたドプラ超音波検査を用い、分娩時期を最適化しました。結論:妊娠中に絨毛癌と診断された場合、中大脳動脈ドプラ超音波検査は、胎児貧血の検出、胎児成熟のための妊娠延長、胎児母体間出血の監視において重要な手段となりえます。妊娠中に診断された絨毛癌の分娩時期決定にドプラ超音波検査を用いた、私たちが知る限り初めての症例報告です。
